adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute the calendar id as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId`. When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `find(...)` branch runs), the predicate compares `cal.externalId` to that same falsy value (e.g., `undefined`/`null`), which will not match normal destination calendars that have real `externalId`s. This makes the destinationCalendar fallback effectively dead and causes the code to proceed with an undefined calendar id (and likely fall back to default/primary behavior downstream), matching the finding.
